# Almanya Pusulası repository instructions

Brand identity is release-critical.

Before branded design work, read:
- `BRAND-IDENTITY.md`
- `BRAND-PRODUCTION-GUARD.md`

Hard rules:
- Never generate, redraw, trace, imitate or approximate the Almanya Pusulası logo.
- AI-generated imagery may be background-only; final branding must composite the exact canonical repo logo.
- Canonical logo: `assets/brand/almanya-pusulasi-logo.png`.
- No fallback logo, compass symbol or invented wordmark.
- Use the locked brand palette and clean sans-serif typography.
- Run `node scripts/validate-brand-lock.js` and treat failure as blocking.
